The player's Miscellania approval is stored as a number between 0 and 127 and that value is divided by 127 to calculate approval as a percentage (truncated to a whole number). Drinking this bottle subtracts 24 from the current approval value, so depending on the initial value it may reduce approval by either 18% or 19% (because 24 is ~18.89% of 127). However, if the initial value is less than 24 (0-23) that intended subtraction would result in a negative approval, which is not allowed. So, instead of producing a negative result, the game resets the approval to the default minimum of 32 (equivalent to 25%). As that default value (32) is greater the small initial values (0-23) that generate it, that means that the bottle's subtraction effect sometimes results in a paradoxical increase of the overall approval rating.
